notes: Jabari Tries is about a young boy who persists through failure while trying to build a flying machine with his little sister and dad. Key themes are perseverance, engineering, and emotional regulation. The existing activity_images vocab (machine, wings, ramp, rocket, yard, sister, tools, tape, straw, dad, cardboard, wheel) covers the concrete story objects well. The fringe_11 chosen here layers in key actions (build, fly, crash, try, fix, again), emotions (frustrated, proud), and descriptive concepts (heavy, light, idea) that support retelling and discussion. Teachers may wish to swap 'heavy' and 'light' for 'sister' or 'dad' if those characters are already covered in activity_images and displayed separately on the board.
